content:
**Added M8 per-stage SDD engine routing (supersedes ADR-0019)**

What: Owner clarified premise #2 (SDD-agnostic with stage config) and approved a NEW epic milestone M8 = per-stage SDD engine ROUTING.
Idea: a configurable stage->engine map so each SDD phase is handled by a possibly-different engine, multiple engines coexisting, owner picks per stage. Example: sdd-new -> gentle-ai, sdd-verify -> brain-sdd, sdd-archive -> gentle-ai. Currently they use gentle-ai + an external reviewer.
CRITICAL design implication: this is EXACTLY the alternative ADR-0019 REJECTED (adr-0019-harness-port.md:63-66, 'expand VALID_OPS to route scaffold/verify/archive per-backend'). Adopting it requires a NEW ADR that consciously SUPERSEDES ADR-0019's neutral-single-lifecycle core. Not an increment — a deliberate reversal. Invariant to preserve: the artifact/evidence contract (openspec layout) stays fixed even as engines differ per stage; engines normalize into the same evidence.
Depends on M5 (#312 role-as-port): the role port and the stage->engine binding share config surface.
Deliverables: ADR (supersede ADR-0019); stage->engine resolver + schema in brain.config.json; >=2 engines wired per stage (gentle-ai + a real brain-sdd/plain); contract/parity test; guard the artifact contract doesn't fork.
Sequence: M5 -> M8 -> M6 -> M7. Docs: docs/inbox/brain-v2-epic-plan.md (M8 section).
Also: launched judgment-day (jd-judge-a + jd-judge-b, opus) against the reviewer subsystem (brain/scripts/review/** + reviewer-protocol.md) per owner request. Awaiting both verdicts; will ask before any fix (Round 1 rule).
Related: [[architecture/sdd-role-neutrality]] [[architecture/v2-epic-plan]] [[architecture/v2-conformance-scorecard]].
